thesis: An AI agent can develop Hazard Forge end-to-end: discover capabilities here, drive each behind a headless flag, and verify its own change against a byte-identical golden oracle — no human, no GUI in the loop.

verifyContract.oracle: a byte-identical golden (image or text) is the machine-checkable pass/fail; the digest is the correctness signal an agent reads without a human.
verifyContract.driver: samples/hello_triangle (headless showcase flags) + ctest (pure-CPU deterministic tests)
verifyContract.howToVerify: to add/verify capability X: run its flag F, byte-compare its golden G; equal bytes == PASS, any diff == FAIL.
verifyContract.moatVsUe5: UE5 is structurally agent-hostile: a GUI-bound editor (no headless authored-scene->verify loop) and non-deterministic float simulation (no byte-identical golden oracle). HF is headless + deterministic by construction.
